## Proposed change
Somfy recently changed the rules about polling their server to get the latest status. The purpose of this PR is to apply these rules.

```
We are contacting you today to inform you about the new rules we are now applying to the API:

    First of all, no limitation will be applied on the POST /device/{deviceId}/exec endpoint as we want to provide you a total freedom on controlling your devices.
    On the other hand, polling frequency on the GET /site and child endpoints will now have to be under 1 call per minute.
```

- https://github.com/tetienne/somfy-open-api/releases/tag/v0.9.4
- https://github.com/tetienne/somfy-open-api/releases/tag/v0.10.1

Indeed, but the Somfy TaHoma integration (internal API) is using an event listener provided by Somfy, where the Somfy integration (official API) is retrieving all states every interval. Since they have a pull (instead of push) approach for the event listener, you will see a lot of requests to tahomalink.com. However, most of these requests just result in an empty JSON response (`{}`) and are not consuming a lot of resources on the Somfy side.

I don't have any faith in the official Somfy API, since it is limited in functionality (like described above), but also lacks support for many devices. We are working on adding this Overkiz integration (underlying platform name) to core in https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/49403.
